derrame.evidencia: The tank is at {{nivelTanque}} % and the pump is still delivering (motor load {{cargaMotor}} %).
derrame.consecuencia: If the pump does not stop, the level can reach the overflow and spill water into the bund.
derrame.accion: Confirm that the high-level cut-out is working and that the control loop responds.

marcha-en-seco.evidencia: The tank is at {{nivelTanque}} % —below the {{minNivel}} % mark— and the pump is delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
marcha-en-seco.consecuencia: Drawing with insufficient level causes cavitation and can destroy the mechanical seal and the bearings in a short time.
marcha-en-seco.accion: Check the actual level and the low-level protection before pumping any further.

sobrepresion.evidencia: Gauge pressure {{presionRelativa}} with the pump delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
sobrepresion.consecuencia: Holding the network above its service pressure punishes gaskets, seals and the weakest runs, and can cause a rupture.
sobrepresion.accion: Review the VFD setpoint and the state of the relief valve.

obstruccion.evidencia: High pressure ({{presionRelativa}}) with low flow ({{flujoInstantaneo}}) and the motor loaded to {{cargaMotor}} %.
obstruccion.consecuencia: The pump is pushing against a resistance: consistent with a closed valve, a dirty filter or a blockage in the line. Working like this heats the pump and wastes energy.
obstruccion.accion: Check the valves on the discharge line and the condition of the filters.

bomba-sin-salida.titulo: The pump is running against a closed outlet
bomba-sin-salida.evidencia: Flow {{flujoInstantaneo}} —practically nil— with pressure {{presionRelativa}} and the pump delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
bomba-sin-salida.consecuencia: With no flow there is no water to carry the heat away: all the shaft power stays inside the pump, heating the same trapped liquid. The mechanical seal and the impeller are damaged in minutes, not weeks, and the steam that forms can burst the volute.
bomba-sin-salida.accion: Check whether the discharge valve is closed and whether there is a minimum recirculation line. Stop the pump rather than opening it suddenly: opening against a hot pump sends a water hammer into the network.
bomba-sin-salida.nota: The «there is pressure» threshold is still an estimate of ours, not a figure from the plant.

posible-fuga.evidencia: High flow ({{flujoInstantaneo}}) with low pressure ({{presionRelativa}}) and the pump delivering.
posible-fuga.consecuencia: Plenty of flow with no pressure is what you see when the network is open somewhere: consistent with a leak, a burst or an outlet left open.
posible-fuga.accion: Walk the network looking for an abnormal discharge and compare against the expected consumption.

esfuerzo-sin-resultado.titulo: The motor is working and moving little
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.evidencia: Motor load {{cargaMotor}} % moving a flow of {{flujoInstantaneo}}.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.consecuencia: High consumption with no hydraulic work in return. Consistent with a worn impeller, a blockage or a mechanical problem, and sustained it heats the motor.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.accion: Compare against the pump's usual operating point at that load.

tension-fuera-con-motor.titulo: Supply out of tolerance with the motor under load
tension-fuera-con-motor.evidencia: Line voltage {{tensionLinea}} V, outside the {{minTension}}–{{maxTension}} V range, with the motor at {{cargaMotor}} %.
tension-fuera-con-motor.consecuencia: Feeding a loaded motor out of tolerance overheats the windings and shortens their life; below the minimum it also raises the current drawn.
tension-fuera-con-motor.accion: Review the supply and the VFD protections.

variador-en-manual.evidencia: The VFD mode reads as Manual.
variador-en-manual.consecuencia: In Manual the automatic systems that protect the plant may not act: control depends on whoever is operating.
variador-en-manual.accion: Confirm that operating in Manual is intentional and that somebody is attending to it.
variador-en-manual.nota: The Automatic/Manual correspondence is not confirmed on the server.

agua-caliente.evidencia: The water in the tank is at {{temperaturaTanque}} °C.
agua-caliente.consecuencia: Above its service band the water loses its fitness for the process, and if it keeps rising the risk of cavitation at the suction increases.
agua-caliente.accion: Check the heat input and the turnover of the tank.

nivel-critico-con-bomba-impulsando.titulo: Critical level alarm and the pump is still delivering
nivel-critico-con-bomba-impulsando.evidencia: The PLC high-high level alarm is active and the pump is still delivering (motor load {{cargaMotor}} %).
nivel-critico-con-bomba-impulsando.consecuencia: The PLC itself already declares the level critical and pumping has not stopped: what is failing is not the detection, it is that the order to stop is not getting through, or nobody has given it.
nivel-critico-con-bomba-impulsando.accion: Confirm whether the high-high level interlock is bypassed and who is commanding the pump.

emergencia-con-motor-en-carga.titulo: Emergency stop requested and the motor is still drawing power
emergencia-con-motor-en-carga.evidencia: The emergency stop is engaged and the motor is still at a load of {{cargaMotor}} %.
emergencia-con-motor-en-carga.consecuencia: An emergency stop that does not cut the drive leaves the plant without its last protection: whoever pressed it did so expecting the machine to stop.
emergencia-con-motor-en-carga.accion: Check the safety chain between the pushbutton and the contactor, and do not treat the machine as stopped while there is load.

variador-en-falla-y-sigue-mandando.titulo: The VFD reports a fault and the motor is still under load
variador-en-falla-y-sigue-mandando.evidencia: The drive reports an active fault and the motor is still at a load of {{cargaMotor}} %.
variador-en-falla-y-sigue-mandando.consecuencia: A drive in fault is not governing the motor the way the automatic system believes: the load being read may not match the setpoint, and its protections may not be active.
variador-en-falla-y-sigue-mandando.accion: Read the fault code on the drive before resetting it, and find out what is keeping the motor under load.

orden-sin-respuesta.titulo: A solenoid valve is not responding to the order it has
orden-sin-respuesta.evidencia: The lower solenoid valve has an order to open and its state reads as "Off" ({{estadoS1}}).
orden-sin-respuesta.consecuencia: The automatic system believes the valve is open and the process behaves as if it were not. Everything that depends on that water path —filling, recirculation— is operating on a false assumption.
orden-sin-respuesta.accion: Check the coil supply and the limit switch before trusting the state the automatic system reports.
orden-sin-respuesta.nota: A single reading can fall in the instant between the order and the movement; what matters is that it persists.

actuador-en-error.titulo: A solenoid valve reports an error
actuador-en-error.evidencia: The lower solenoid valve reports its state as "Error".
actuador-en-error.consecuencia: The equipment declares that it cannot perform its function. While it stays that way, its actual position cannot be taken as known in either direction.
actuador-en-error.accion: Inspect the actuator and find out what condition left it in error before resetting it.

bloqueo-de-mantenimiento-con-proceso-en-.titulo: A maintenance lock is in place while the process is running
bloqueo-de-mantenimiento-con-proceso-en-.evidencia: The lower solenoid valve is locked for maintenance and the pump is still delivering (load {{cargaMotor}} %).
bloqueo-de-mantenimiento-con-proceso-en-.consecuencia: A locked element does not obey the automatic system: any manoeuvre that needs it will not be carried out, even if the control asks for it.
bloqueo-de-mantenimiento-con-proceso-en-.accion: Confirm that the lock is intentional and that whoever set it knows the process is running.

alarma-de-proceso-sin-respaldo-analogico.titulo: The PLC pressure alarm and our reading do not agree
alarma-de-proceso-sin-respaldo-analogico.evidencia: The PLC has the high-pressure alarm active and the reading is {{presionRelativa}}, below our warning threshold ({{avisoPresion}}).
alarma-de-proceso-sin-respaldo-analogico.consecuencia: The PLC alarm and this dashboard's threshold are not describing the same plant. The alarm prevails —it was set by whoever knows the process— so most likely the threshold here is badly calibrated.
alarma-de-proceso-sin-respaldo-analogico.accion: Compare the limit configured in the PLC against the one in this dashboard before trusting the pressure bands.
alarma-de-proceso-sin-respaldo-analogico.nota: Our pressure thresholds are still an estimate, not a figure from the plant.

sobrecorriente-o-cortocircuito.titulo: Overcurrent at the output (F1): short circuit, earth fault or a badly parameterised motor

sobretension-de-bus.titulo: DC link overvoltage (F2): deceleration too fast, or a high supply

subtension-de-alimentacion.titulo: Supply undervoltage (F3): a dip or a brief outage on the mains

sobretemperatura.titulo: Drive or motor overtemperature (F4, F5, F11): ventilation or duty cycle

disparo-de-vigilancia-de-carga.titulo: Load monitoring trip (F452): a mechanical fault in the drive train, or a seizure

corte-nivel-alto-no-actua.titulo: The automatic high-level cut-out is not acting

lazo-de-control-no-responde.titulo: The control loop is not responding although the level alarm is active

aporte-externo-no-controlado.titulo: Water is entering the tank through a path the control does not govern

nivel-real-insuficiente.titulo: The actual tank level is insufficient

proteccion-nivel-bajo-no-actua.titulo: The low-level protection is not acting

consigna-variador-alta.titulo: The VFD setpoint is above what it should be

valvula-alivio-no-actua.titulo: The relief valve is not acting

fuga-o-rotura-en-la-red.titulo: Leak, burst or an outlet left open in the network

salida-quedada-abierta.titulo: An outlet of the network was left open

umbral-de-presion-sin-calibrar.titulo: The low-pressure threshold is still an estimate of ours

enclavamiento-nivel-alto-puenteado.titulo: The high-high level interlock is bypassed or disabled

bomba-mandada-en-manual.titulo: Someone is commanding the pump manually, outside the automatic system

cadena-de-seguridad-interrumpida.titulo: The safety chain does not reach the contactor

lectura-de-emergencia-invertida.titulo: The polarity of the emergency contact is not the one we assume

falla-del-variador-sin-reponer.titulo: The drive has an active fault that has not been reset

motor-alimentado-por-fuera-del-variador.titulo: The motor is being fed through a path that does not go through the drive

umbral-del-tablero-mal-calibrado.titulo: This dashboard's pressure threshold is not the plant's

alarma-y-medida-de-puntos-distintos.titulo: The alarm and the reading are not measuring the same point of the network

bobina-o-alimentacion-de-la-valvula.titulo: The solenoid coil is not being energised, or it is burnt out

final-de-carrera-desajustado.titulo: The limit switch does not confirm the position even though the valve moves

valvula-agarrotada.titulo: The valve is seized and never actually moves

condicion-externa-dejo-el-actuador-en-er.titulo: An external condition left the actuator in error

obstruccion-interna-bomba.titulo: Internal blockage in the pump or the line

problema-en-el-suministro.titulo: A problem in the electrical supply

aporte-termico-externo.titulo: External heat input to the tank

falta-renovacion-de-agua.titulo: Not enough water turnover in the tank

rodamiento-en-mal-estado.titulo: Bearing in poor condition at that support

holgura-que-golpea.titulo: Mechanical looseness knocking on every turn

fijacion-floja-en-el-apoyo.componente: Fixing bolts of the indicated support

desalineacion-localizada.titulo: Coupling misalignment pulling on that side
desalineacion-localizada.componente: Coupling, on the side of the indicated support

cavitacion-acumulada.componente: Mechanical seal and impeller of the pump
cavitacion-acumulada.mecanismo: With a low level, the pressure at the suction falls below the vapour pressure and bubbles form that implode against the impeller. Each implosion tears off a minute amount of material; the damage accumulates and does not undo itself.
cavitacion-acumulada.consecuencia: Impeller erosion, a progressive loss of flow at the same speed, and destruction of the mechanical seal — which is usually what fails first, and what forces the pump open.
cavitacion-acumulada.accion: Review the low-level stop setpoint and the reaction time of the loop.

sobrepresion-sostenida.titulo: Hours with the network above its service pressure
sobrepresion-sostenida.componente: Gaskets, seals and the weakest runs of the network
sobrepresion-sostenida.mecanismo: The elastomers in gaskets and seals deform permanently under sustained pressure (compression set). It is not a failure from exceeding a limit once: it is fatigue proportional to the time accumulated above the design pressure.
sobrepresion-sostenida.consecuencia: Leaks at gaskets, a progressive loss of tightness and, at worst, a run rupturing from fatigue.
sobrepresion-sostenida.accion: Review the VFD setpoint and the setting of the relief valve.

agua-caliente-sostenida.titulo: Hours with the water above its band
agua-caliente-sostenida.componente: Pump suction and fitness of the water
agua-caliente-sostenida.mecanismo: The hotter the water, the lower the pressure at which it boils, and the less suction margin the pump has left before it cavitates. Hot water does no damage on its own: it narrows the margin everything else works with.
agua-caliente-sostenida.consecuencia: It raises the chance of cavitation at levels that used to be sufficient, and the water stops being fit for its process use.
agua-caliente-sostenida.accion: Check the heat input and the turnover of the tank.

tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.titulo: Hours with the supply out of tolerance
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.componente: Motor windings and the drive DC link
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.mecanismo: Below tolerance, the motor makes up the torque by drawing more current, and current heats the winding. Above it, the core saturates and iron losses rise. In both directions the result is the same variable: insulation temperature. The classic rule —Montsinger, taken up in IEC 60034-1— is that insulation life halves for every 10 K sustained above its class.
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.consecuencia: Accelerated ageing of the stator insulation and of the capacitors in the drive DC link. Neither gives warning: they fail all at once, at the end.
tension-fuera-de-tolerancia.accion: Review the supply and the VFD protections.

esfuerzo-sin-resultado.titulo: Hours moving little flow with the motor loaded
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.mecanismo: Working far from the best efficiency point loads the shaft asymmetrically: the radial force on the impeller grows and unloads entirely onto the bearings.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.consecuencia: Accelerated wear of bearings and of the seal, and consumption with no useful work.
esfuerzo-sin-resultado.accion: Compare the real operating point against the pump's curve.

velocidad-fuera-de-norma.titulo: The machine is turning too slowly to be judged against ISO 10816
velocidad-fuera-de-norma.evidencia: The drive is delivering {{frecuencia}} Hz and the motor is turning at {{velocidad}} rpm, below the {{rpmMinima}} rpm from which the standard will make a judgement.
velocidad-fuera-de-norma.consecuencia: RMS velocity readings come out LOW by construction: at this speed the running frequency falls outside the 10–1000 Hz band the standard measures, and the filter attenuates the unbalance component. A «within limits» here does not mean the machine is well; it means the standard has not spoken.
velocidad-fuera-de-norma.accion: To assess against ISO, measure with the machine at its service speed. In the meantime, go by aRMS and by the comparison between supports, which do not depend on that band.

velocidad-en-el-borde-de-la-banda.titulo: The machine is turning right at the lower edge of the measurement band
velocidad-en-el-borde-de-la-banda.evidencia: {{velocidad}} rpm is {{hz}} Hz of rotation, just above the 10 Hz at which the standard’s measurement band begins.
velocidad-en-el-borde-de-la-banda.consecuencia: The 10 Hz high-pass filter does not cut sharply: at its own corner frequency it attenuates by close to 30 %. The unbalance component, which weighs most in RMS velocity, comes in clipped. The ISO verdict still holds, but with less margin than the figure suggests.
velocidad-en-el-borde-de-la-banda.accion: If a reliable baseline measurement is wanted, take it with the machine at its service speed, where the band picks it up whole.

por-debajo-del-minimo-del-modulo.titulo: The machine is turning below what the module can measure
por-debajo-del-minimo-del-modulo.evidencia: {{velocidad}} rpm, below the {{rpmMinima}} rpm minimum of the SIPLUS CMS SM 1281.
por-debajo-del-minimo-del-modulo.consecuencia: The module does not guarantee its measurements below that speed. What it is publishing right now is not comparable with anything.
por-debajo-del-minimo-del-modulo.accion: Do not decide anything on these readings. Repeat at normal running speed.

medida-en-vacio.titulo: The machine is turning off load
medida-en-vacio.evidencia: Drive torque is {{par}} %: the machine is turning, but it is not working.
medida-en-vacio.evidencia_conPotencia: Drive torque is {{par}} % and power {{potencia}} kW: the machine is turning, but it is not working.
medida-en-vacio.consecuencia: Off load, the vibrations that only show under load do not appear — misalignment forced by torque, clearances that close up, cavitation. A clean measurement here does not rule out a problem in service.
medida-en-vacio.accion: Take the baseline measurement with the machine in its normal working condition, not off load.

factor-de-cresta-alto.titulo: The acceleration is made of impacts, not noise
factor-de-cresta-alto.evidencia: Crest factor {{cresta}}: the peak acceleration ({{aPeak}} m/s²) is {{cresta}} times the RMS ({{aRMS}} m/s²), above {{limite}}, at {{par}} % torque.
factor-de-cresta-alto.consecuencia: A high crest factor under load usually comes from short, repeated impacts: a bearing with a pitted race, or a looseness that knocks on every turn. Unbalance and misalignment do not raise it: they are nearly sinusoidal. RMS velocity can stay in zone A while this happens.
factor-de-cresta-alto.accion: Check whether the bearing monitors (BPFO, BPFI, FTF) are enabled on that support and what they say; check clearances and tightness. If it persists under load, schedule a bearing inspection.

vibracion-en-alarma.evidencia: RMS velocity {{vRMS}} mm/s, above the {{limite}} mm/s at which ISO 10816-1 Class I places zone D.
vibracion-en-alarma.consecuencia: Zone D is the damage zone: at this level the machine is deteriorating while it runs. The usual causes in this range are significant unbalance, misalignment or a loose baseplate.
vibracion-en-alarma.accion: Stop as soon as the process allows and check balancing, alignment and the fixing of the baseplate.

vibracion-en-aviso.titulo: Vibration above the level for prolonged running
vibracion-en-aviso.evidencia: RMS velocity {{vRMS}} mm/s: zone C of ISO 10816-1 Class I (above {{limite}} mm/s).
vibracion-en-aviso.consecuencia: Zone C is «unsatisfactory»: the machine can carry on running, but not indefinitely. Leaving it there shortens the life of the bearings and of the coupling.
vibracion-en-aviso.accion: Schedule an intervention. There is no need to stop today.

alarma-del-modulo.titulo: The vibration module has its alarm output on
alarma-del-modulo.evidencia: The SM 1281 has raised its alarm output for this channel.
alarma-del-modulo.consecuencia: The module has crossed one of its own thresholds for the configured delay time. It does not say WHICH: it may be velocity, acceleration or damage value.
alarma-del-modulo.accion: Look in the module’s web server for the specific limit that has been exceeded, and contrast it with the measurements on this screen.

aviso-del-modulo.titulo: The vibration module has its warning output on
aviso-del-modulo.evidencia: The SM 1281 has raised its warning output for this channel.
aviso-del-modulo.consecuencia: The warning threshold has been crossed, which is the one meant to warn before there is damage. This is the useful moment to act.
aviso-del-modulo.accion: Find out which measurement in particular tripped it, before it rises further.

dkw-sin-referencia.titulo: The damage value has no learned baseline
dkw-sin-referencia.evidencia: The server delivers no damage value for this channel: either the baseline has not been learned, or the channel is not in monitoring mode.
dkw-sin-referencia.consecuencia: The damage value is the measurement that catches a bearing starting to pit soonest — before velocity and before acceleration. With no baseline, that early warning does not exist for this support.
dkw-sin-referencia.accion: Leave the module in «RUN: Measure» with the machine healthy, then press «Apply» in the DKW configuration of its web server. Careful: if it is learned with an already damaged bearing, the damage ends up INSIDE the baseline and the watch starts out blind.

sensor-con-desviacion.titulo: The sensor is reporting an offset
sensor-con-desviacion.consecuencia: An offset other than zero points at the mounting or the wiring of the accelerometer — a loose base, insufficient tightening torque, IEPE supply at its limit — not at the machine. While it is there, every measurement on this channel carries the error.
sensor-con-desviacion.accion: Check the mounting of the probe and its cable before believing any other reading from this channel.

variador-en-fallo.titulo: The drive of this machine is in fault
variador-en-fallo.evidencia_conUltimo: `FAULT_BMS` reads {{fallo}} and the last fault on record was {{ultimoFallo}}.
variador-en-fallo.consecuencia: With the drive in fault, the published speed may not match what the shaft is doing, and every vibration assessment that depends on it is left hanging.
variador-en-fallo.accion: Deal with the drive fault before interpreting the vibrations.

rodamientos-sin-vigilar.evidencia: {{n}} of 3 bearing watches are not watching anything at this support: {{cuales}}.
rodamientos-sin-vigilar.consecuencia: The module computes the envelope spectrum and knows the exact frequencies at which each bearing defect strikes. With that switched off, a bearing that is pitting will only show once it has risen enough to move the RMS value — and by then the damage is done.
rodamientos-sin-vigilar.accion: Configure the bearing geometry in the channel: number of rolling elements, pitch diameter, element diameter and contact angle. Without those four figures the module cannot compute BPFO, BPFI or FTF, which is why it leaves them off.

medida-sin-vigilar.titulo: Some measurements are published but not watched
medida-sin-vigilar.evidencia: Published, but nobody compares them against a limit: {{cuales}}.
medida-sin-vigilar.consecuencia: The value appears on screen and looks watched. It is not: if it rises, the module will raise neither warning nor alarm.
medida-sin-vigilar.accion: Set a threshold for that measurement in the channel, or accept that it is informative only.

vigilancia-en-aviso.titulo: The module has a watch in warning or alarm
vigilancia-en-aviso.consecuencia: The module has crossed one of its own criteria. Unlike the general alarm and warning flags, this one says WHICH watch in particular has tripped.
vigilancia-en-aviso.accion: Look at that measurement in the module’s web server and contrast it with the other supports before touching anything.
vigilancia-en-aviso.nota: The reading of this state is inferred, not confirmed against the SM 1281 manual.

confianza-de-medida-baja.titulo: The module distrusts one of its own measurements
confianza-de-medida-baja.evidencia: Below the {{nominal}} seen with the machine healthy: {{bajas}}.
confianza-de-medida-baja.consecuencia: The module publishes a confidence figure alongside each measurement. When it drops, the number goes on being published just the same: it cannot be told from a good one by looking at it.
confianza-de-medida-baja.accion: Check the mounting of the probe, and that the machine is above the module’s minimum running speed, before believing that measurement.

alarmas-activas.titulo: The alarm server has active alarms in this area
alarmas-activas.evidencia_severidad: {{total}} active alarm(s) in «DEMO VIBRACIONES». Highest severity {{severidad}}.
alarmas-activas.evidencia_ambos: {{total}} active alarm(s) in «DEMO VIBRACIONES», {{sinReconocer}} unacknowledged. Highest severity {{severidad}}.
alarmas-activas.consecuencia: These are the server’s alarms, not deductions made by this screen: somebody set their limits deliberately, and they override anything concluded here.
alarmas-activas.accion: Open the ICONICS alarm viewer to see WHICH they are. This screen can only count them: the API does not expose the state alarm by alarm.
alarmas-activas.nota: What is read is the area counter. Which of the 57 configured alarms has tripped cannot be known from here.

alarmas-sin-reconocer.titulo: Alarms tripped and nobody acknowledged them
alarmas-sin-reconocer.evidencia: {{n}} alarm(s) in «DEMO VIBRACIONES» tripped and went back to normal without anybody acknowledging them.
alarmas-sin-reconocer.consecuencia: The machine is well NOW. But something took it out of band while nobody was looking, and with them unacknowledged there is no record that anyone checked what it was.
alarmas-sin-reconocer.accion: Review and acknowledge those alarms in the ICONICS viewer, so that the next one to appear can be told apart from the old ones.

asimetria-entre-apoyos.titulo: One support vibrates far more than the others
asimetria-entre-apoyos.evidencia: {{canal}} measures {{valor}} m/s² of RMS acceleration, {{veces}} times what the rest of the supports on the same machine measure ({{referencia}} m/s² median).
asimetria-entre-apoyos.consecuencia: A large difference between supports on the same shaft is usually local: a bearing in poor condition, a loose base, or misalignment pulling on that side. If it were a whole-machine problem, they would all rise together.
asimetria-entre-apoyos.accion: Look at that support first: tightness of the fixing, condition of the bearing and alignment of the coupling at that end.
